classification: No stable new ctgrind context is introduced. The RSA CRT context count remains inside the recorded 105-112 band; the ECDSA count is at or below its 190-context baseline. ctgrind reports control flow and addresses, not variable-latency instructions, and a clean count is not a constant-time proof.
comparison_control_flow: The modulus-equality test is a full-width XOR/OR accumulation with one final equality branch. It reveals only whether the operand and the stored copy agree; on the legitimate path they always agree. It has no per-limb early exit and is classified SECRET_DEPENDENT_CONTROL with a declassification boundary at the refusal decision.
